title: Exoto 1:18 Tyrrell Ford 003 Jackie Stewart 1971 German GP #2 AS-IS
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars: Racing, NASCAR:Other Diecast Racing Cars
conditionDescription: Damaged, sold as-is: one front wheel is detached from its axle mount (loose, included), and one wing mirror is broken off (loose, included). Please review all photos closely.
descriptionText:
Exoto 1:18 scale diecast, "Grand Prix Classics" series (GPC97020), 1971 Tyrrell Ford 003, Jackie Stewart #2, Elf/Team Tyrrell livery, winner of the 1971 German Grand Prix. Highly detailed model with exposed engine, suspension, and driver figure.
Sold as-is: one front wheel has detached from its axle mount (wheel included loose, not reattached), and one wing mirror is broken off (included loose, see photos). Everything shown in the photos is included. Great project piece for a collector comfortable with diecast repair.
